facts.fact: ANADEN's legal affairs officer lists a law on e-commerce among legislation still to be drafted (a elaborer), to be part of a digital code targeted for 2024, so no e-commerce law or draft existed in March 2021.

The national digital strategy states that the telecommunications-centred legal framework leaves a legal vacuum on digital transactions and electronic signature; the volume gives no date, so as_of is the December 2018 drawing-up date given in the document's record.
facts.system: digital transactions and electronic signature legal framework

systems.owner: Government of Comoros; funded by French Embassy, UNICEF technical support

note: Civil registry law only; no e-commerce or electronic transactions law stated.
Information and communication code covers media, advertising, AI labelling and personal data; the document does not say it covers electronic transactions or online selling.
Civil-status law abstract only; nothing on e-commerce or electronic transactions law.
Finance law provision treats tax declarations via taxpayer account as electronic signature, for tax filing only; not a law on electronic transactions or e-commerce, so no fact.

facts.fact: Digital Watch Observatory states Comoros has no clearly verified standalone e-commerce law publicly available; no date given for the statement, so the page's published date 2024-01-01 is used.

The UNECA Digital Trade Regulatory Integration profile states that the Comoros does not have a law on electronic transactions and has no consumer protection framework or UNCITRAL-based legislation for online transactions; it is undated, so its published date of 2024 is used (data covers 2005-2023).

The same profile states that the 2021 law on cyber security and the fight against cybercrime fills gaps in electronic transactions, notably legal recognition of electronic signatures with the same effect as handwritten ones; it also calls an Electronic Signature Act adopted, in its conclusion.
facts.system: Law on cyber security and the fight against cybercrime (Law No. 21-012/AU)
